item.title: Natural audience choices for personal group questions
item.summary: When a group asks someone's personal Murph for help, Murph follows the requester's ordinary wording to answer here or privately.
item.details: If the audience is genuinely unclear, Murph asks a normal follow-up instead of requiring special phrasing. Before a personal answer is prepared for the group, Murph tells the room it will be shared there. Every request stays bound to the exact sender and message, expires within ten minutes, and grants no future access.
